name: @pipeworx/mcp-devdocs-io

tools.name: docs
tools.description: Return the full DevDocs.io catalog of all available documentation sets: name, slug, type, version, and release for every supported library/language.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Find which documentation SETS exist whose NAME matches a substring (e.g. "python" → Python 3.x, "react" → React). Returns doc SETS, NOT their content — this does NOT look up a function/method/API name. To search inside a doc for an entry like "Array.map" or "fetch", use search_index (slug + query).

query.description: Substring of a documentation-set name, e.g. "javascript", "postgres".

tools.name: index
tools.description: Index of entries inside a doc.

tools.name: search_index
tools.description: Search WITHIN a documentation set for a specific entry (method/function/API/property) by substring — THIS is the content lookup. E.g. slug="javascript", query="Array.map"; slug="python", query="os.path". Get valid slugs from docs/search_docs.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-devdocs-io forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the devdocs-io pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
